NVIDIA is moving to change the personal computing industry by force. The company is now partnering with Microsoft in a way that creates a relatively closed-loop system between the two companies -- NVIDIA providing the CPU and GPU and Microsoft providing the sloperating system. Over the past week, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang has advocated for more energy production, more "baby production," and has had to face questions about police raids in Taiwan over GPU smuggling operations of Supermicro servers. The company also just announced its N1, N1X, and RTX Spark solutions, spread across laptops, desktops, and workstations, and all focused on "AI."

Our documentary on the COLLAPSE of the Personal Computing industry:
title: NVIDIA's Hostile Takeover
